Body.Content:
Quick-start planning templates provide a guided, business-first experience for setting up planning in Business performance planning. Instead of selecting technical objects like fact tables, users simply choose a planning area—starting with OPEX, with Revenue, Workforce, and CAPEX to follow.

When a planning area is selected, Business performance planning automatically generates the required data model, including cubes and dimensions, using recommended fact tables from Business performance analytics.

A prebuilt Power BI app is then available to install and connect directly to the organization’s Business performance analytics environment. The app includes ready-to-use planning reports, allowing users to enter data, view results, and analyze scenarios with their own data immediately.

This capability reduces proof-of-concept setup from weeks to minutes and provides a repeatable path for customers and partners to accelerate adoption across multiple planning domains.

Business Value:

Instead of configuring cubes, dimensions, and reports manually, finance teams can immediately experience planning by selecting a business planning area (starting with OPEX). The system automatically generates the required model and connects to a prebuilt Power BI app, allowing planning to begin in minutes. This reduces proof-of-concept setup from weeks to clicks, accelerating time to value and simplifying adoption.

Enabled for:

Enabled for end users automatically

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/finance/business-performance-planning/business-performance-planning-overview

GA date: October CY2026
